jobs.title: Angular FE Developer
jobs.description:
ALTEN Romania
is part of the ALTEN Group, a leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and sustainable technical solutions that meet the needs of our local and international partners.
About the role:
We are looking for a Front-End Developer with at least 4 years of relevant experience, ideally 5+ years, to join a project in fragrance, beauty, taste and wellbeing. The role focuses on developing and maintaining web applications, with a strong emphasis on user experience, performance and code quality.
To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills:
Minimum 4 years of professional front-end development experience, ideally 5+ years, with strong hands-on Angular expertise.
Practical experience with recent Angular versions (Angular 20+).
Strong knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3/SCSS.
Experience with standalone components, Angular Signals, dependency injection, routing and reactive forms.
Good understanding of RxJS, Observables and asynchronous programming.
Experience integrating REST APIs, including authentication and error handling.
Familiarity with component-based architecture, reusable code and front-end performance optimization.
Experience with unit testing and Git-based collaborative development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks.
Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
A typical day might include the following:
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular and TypeScript.
Build reusable components and implement intuitive interfaces based on business requirements and UI/UX designs.
Integrate REST APIs in collaboration with back-end developers.
Manage asynchronous data flows and application state.
Ensure application performance, accessibility and cross-browser compatibility.
Write and maintain automated tests, participate in code reviews and resolve technical issues.
Contribute to front-end architecture decisions and upgrades to newer Angular versions.
Collaborate with developers, testers and business stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience with Angular 21 or 22.
Experience migrating applications between Angular versions.
Familiarity with Angular Material or other UI component libraries.
Experience with state management solutions such as NgRx.
Experience with end-to-end testing using Playwright or Cypress.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Agile methodologies.
Only eligible candidates will be contacted within a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information provided is treated as confidential.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer - DealWise @ING Hubs Romania
jobs.description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING's software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Here's a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:
At ING, we're building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agree
The Mission
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in web components and JavaScript frameworks to join our dynamic team. As a Frontend Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing user interfaces for our web applications. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in frontend development, a deep understanding of web technologies, and a passion for creating seamless and visually appealing user experiences.
Your day to day
Frontend Development & Web Components
Develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable frontend applications.
Build modular Web Components using technologies such as Lit and modern JavaScript frameworks.
Translate UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality user interfaces.
Contribute to shared component libraries and frontend standards.
Promote coding best practices, maintainability, and consistency across applications.
Microfrontend Architecture
Design, develop, and maintain solutions within a microfrontend architecture.
Ensure seamless integration between independently developed frontend applications.
Support modularization, scalability, and independent delivery of frontend capabilities.
Contribute to frontend architecture evolution and technical decision-making.
State Management
Implement and maintain scalable state management solutions using Redux or similar technologies.
Define effective patterns for data flow and asynchronous operations.
Ensure predictable application behavior and maintainable state structures.
Support communication across frontend modules and applications.
Accessibility & User Experience
Develop accessible user interfaces that comply with WCAG and WAI-ARIA guidelines.
Perform accessibility reviews and remediation activities.
Ensure compatibility with assistive technologies.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessibility best practices.
Performance Optimization
Optimize application performance and loading times.
Identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks, memory issues, and performance concerns.
Improve Core Web Vitals and overall user experience.
Continuously monitor and enhance frontend performance.
Testing & Quality Engineering
Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Collaborate with QA engineers to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Support automated testing practices.
Participate in code reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
Azure DevOps & CI/CD
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, testing, quality validation, and deployment processes.
Manage source control, build pipelines, release workflows, and artifacts.
Support deployment and release activities across multiple environments.
Troubleshoot build and deployment issues and drive continuous improvement of delivery processes.
AI-Assisted Development
Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered engineering assistants to improve productivity.
Use AI-assisted development techniques for coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Validate and review AI-generated outputs to ensure compliance with quality, security, and maintainability standards.
Contribute to the adoption of responsible AI-assisted development practices within the team.
Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Collaborate with developers, architects, designers, product owners, and QA engineers.
Participate in architectural discussions and technical design reviews.
Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities and best practices.
Support junior and mid-level engineers through mentoring and technical guidance.
Promote a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
What you'll bring to the team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience developing modern frontend applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Hands-on experience with Lit, React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
Strong experience building and maintaining Web Components.
Solid experience with Redux or similar state management solutions.
Experience working within microfrontend architectures.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
Experience implementing accessibility standards (WCAG, WAI-ARIA).
Experience with frontend testing frameworks and automated testing practices.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Adobe Analytics
Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools.
Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization techniques.
Experience with Git-based development workflows.
If you have a passion for building innovative and user-friendly interfaces using the latest web technologies, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of our web applications and providing users with exceptional digital experiences.
If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).

jobs.title: Frontend Software Developer
jobs.description:
Who We Are
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
About This Role
We are seeking a Frontend Software Developer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team within Software & Product Infrastructure. This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining modern, scalable and user-centric web applications using contemporary front-end frameworks, with a particular focus on React and Angular. The successful candidate will work across multiple applications built on different technology stacks, collaborating closely with designers, backend engineers, product teams and clients to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
In addition to software development responsibilities, the role provides technical consultancy and guidance to stakeholders, helping them make informed decisions regarding technologies, solution design and product roadmaps while ensuring high standards of usability, accessibility, performance and maintainability.
What You’ll Do
Develop responsive, accessible and high-quality user interfaces using modern front-end frameworks, including React and Angular
Create clean, maintainable and efficient code that aligns with business requirements and design specifications
Work across multiple applications and adapt to different front-end frameworks, architectures and development standards
Collaborate with designers to transform wireframes and design concepts into engaging, user-friendly web experiences
Ensure consistent functionality and user experience across devices, browsers and screen sizes
Partner with backend developers to integrate front-end components with APIs and server-side services
Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with project objectives and timelines
Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance
Conduct peer code reviews and support quality assurance activities to maintain development standards
Troubleshoot, debug and resolve technical issues efficiently
Implement front-end optimisation techniques, including lazy loading, caching and performance improvements
Promote engineering best practices including version control, continuous integration and code review processes
Create and maintain technical documentation, component libraries, development guides and user-facing documentation
Explore emerging technologies, frameworks and tools, sharing knowledge with colleagues to support innovation and continuous improvement
Provide technical consultancy to clients on technology choices, development methodologies and solution roadmaps
Build strong stakeholder relationships through proactive communication, problem solving and delivery excellence
Gather client feedback, provide project updates and support alignment between technical delivery and business objectives
Contribute to onboarding activities and knowledge-transfer sessions for new team members
